subject: Dual-track compliance plan: DPA carveouts + audit-log retention / pen-test window
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Brooks <eleanor.brooks@ledgerly.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: compliance priorities and dual-track plan (audit logs + DPA carveouts)

Eleanor / Samir — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment heading into your internal security review. I tried to keep this focused on the items you flagged on the call.

Summary of your pain & goals
- Primary goal: start in a hosted environment but satisfy enterprise retention/DPA constraints for regulated payout data.
- Pain: existing vendor logs are short-lived; Ledgerly needs immutable, customer-scoped audit logs retained for 18 months for transaction traces.
- Concern: pen-test scheduling and evidence timing — you need a clean window aligned with your Q4 audit and a packaged artifacts bundle for SOC 2 reviewers.

What Redwood can offer (high level)
- Audit log export: per-tenant, signed event stream with schema we shared (attached redwood-auditlog-schema-v1.csv). Exports can be S3 push or secure pull with presigned URLs.
- Retention controls: configurable retention per-tenant (30d/90d/365d/18mo) and legal-hold for specific customer IDs.
- DPA carveouts: we support limited subprocessor carveouts for billing/metrics; we can mark certain audit events as PII-redacted at write-time if needed.
- Pen-test: we provide a pen-test support packet (sample evidence list) and a recommended 3-day window; our infra team (cc'd Karthik) will coordinate scoped checks.

Action items I propose (dual-track):
1) Legal track (DPA): Iris: we will send a DPA diff highlighting the carveouts you requested and an optional clause for audit-log custody. (Deliverable: ledgerly-dpa-carveouts-diff.pdf) — target: EOD Thu 8/27.
2) Technical track (audit logs): Karthik to share implementation notes + sample export schema (attached). We can provision a sandbox tenant with 18-month retention and show an export in 48-72 hours.
3) Pen-test window: we recommend tentatively booking a window in the week of Nov 9 — you mentioned Q4 audit alignment. If that works, we'll reserve infra and deliver the evidence bundle within 5 business days post-test.
4) Mutual action plan (MAP): I'll put a short MAP in the shared Drive and a HubSpot task so this doesn't fall through the cracks.

Please confirm: (a) DPA reviewer name/email, (b) preferred export mechanism (S3 push vs pull), and (c) whether Ledgerly needs signed (RPoS) attestations on archived logs.

Thanks — next ping after Karthik uploads the schema and after I send the DPA diff.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-auditlog-schema-v1.csv (CSV, 9KB)]
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan-ledgerly.xlsx (Excel, 18KB)]

From: Eleanor Brooks <eleanor.brooks@ledgerly.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@ledgerly.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: compliance priorities and dual-track plan (audit logs + DPA carveouts)

Thanks, Irene — this is really helpful and captures the conversation. Quick answers to your asks: 

- DPA reviewer: Maya Green (m.green@ledgerly.com) — she'll drive the legal review and loop in procurement.
- Export mechanism: S3 push preferred (Ledgerly already allows inbound pushes from partners). We will provide a dedicated bucket and a cross-account role.
- Signed attestations: yes, we need a signed chain-of-custody manifest for archived logs (will be handed to our auditors).

One clarification: when you say "legal-hold for specific customer IDs" — can that be scoped to a sub-set of event types (for example, payment-settlement events only) rather than entire tenant objects? Our compliance team would prefer a targeted hold.

Pen-test timing: Nov 9–11 works tentatively. Please lock it in with your infra team.

Appreciate the MAP and DPA diff; Maya will expect the DPA doc by Thursday.

Cheers,
Eleanor
Head of Compliance | Ledgerly

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Brooks <eleanor.brooks@ledgerly.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: compliance priorities and dual-track plan (audit logs + DPA carveouts)

Eleanor — brief technical follow-up and answers to the scoped-hold question.

1) Targeted legal-hold: yes. We can apply holds at the event-type level (payment_settlement, refund, dispute) and to individual customer IDs. Implementation note: holds incrementally override the normal retention TTL; held events are moved to an immutable storage bucket (WORM-enabled) and flagged in the index. That meets most auditor expectations for immutability.

2) Export details for S3 push:
- Delivery format: gzipped JSONL with accompanying manifest (SHA256 checksums).
- Scheduling: near-real-time (1–5 min batches) or daily bundles — you pick. For audit purposes we recommend daily bundles with a 1-minute granularity manifest.
- Metadata: every event will include event_id, tenant_id, customer_id, event_type, created_at, actor_id, and a redaction flag if PII is stripped. See the attached schema for the exact field list.

3) Pen-test coordination: we will reserve Nov 9–11 tentatively. Action for Ledgerly: confirm the on-site/remote scoping and provide IP allowlist for the test agents. Action for us: I'll allocate a 2-person infra window and a 1-day evidence prep slot post-test.

Next steps (technical owners):
- Irene: will share the DPA diff with Maya by EOD Thu 8/27.
- Karthik: will spin up a sandbox with 18mo retention and push a sample export to your S3 credentials within 48–72 hours of receiving the bucket ARN.
- Eleanor/Maya: confirm the pen-test scope and IPs by Sep 10 so we can finalize bookings.

Attaching the schema again for convenience.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-auditlog-schema-v1.csv (CSV, 9KB)]
[Attachment: ledgerly-dpa-carveouts-diff.pdf (PDF, 24KB)]
